description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayMappingCommandHandler class in the Eclipse Hono client implementation. It verifies behavior such as gateway resolution logic based on device registration info, last known gateways, and command reply-to handling.

classes.name: GatewayMappingCommandHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class verifying behavior of GatewayMappingCommandHandler, including gateway resolution logic and command handling under various scenarios.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and common test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testHandleUsingEmptyDeviceData
methods.description: Verifies that handle() calls next handler without altering command when registration info has no 'via' entry.

methods.name: testHandleReturningLastUsedGateway
methods.description: Checks that handle() uses the last known gateway if available and 'via' entries exist.

methods.name: testHandleReturningLastUsedGatewayWithCommandReplyToSet
methods.description: Ensures that reply-to header is preserved when adapting command with last gateway info.

methods.name: testHandleReturningSingleViaGateway
methods.description: Validates scenario where only one 'via' gateway exists and no last known gateway; should use the 'via' gateway.

methods.name: testHandleWithNoMappedGatewayFound
methods.description: Confirms behavior when multiple 'via' gateways are present but none can be mapped; command is discarded.

methods.name: testHandleWithRegistrationClientException
methods.description: Tests that exceptions during registration lookup lead to command context release and no further processing.
